name: wechat-article-link-reviewer
description: Review user-supplied WeChat article links and optionally sync results to Feishu Base.
author: Gray

interface.shortDescription: Review supplied WeChat links and save selected results.
interface.longDescription: A link-only workflow for reading, scoring, and organizing user-supplied WeChat articles, with optional controlled Feishu Base synchronization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review only the WeChat article link I supply. Do not discover accounts or request WeChat Cookie/token, and ask before writing this article to Feishu Base.
